limitations: Request ID, issuer, destination, time and assertion-condition checks remain applicable. A usable signed assertion/trust context is still required for the mismatch route; no fixture or fixed regression was executed.

judgments.rationale: Re-review of the changed packet supports its narrowed Local.Path-to-mklink claim. The published CVE and issue 121879 map to PR 121881/merge 620bc81; the export is its first parent and the CNA CVSS 3.1 score 7.2 is accurately retained. Pinned local.go NewMounter/getGlobalLocalPath propagate Local.Path for a directory, then SetUpAt checks backsteps and mount state before MakeAbsolutePath and MountSensitiveWithoutSystemd. These checks do not sanitize cmd metacharacters, but practical availability of a qualifying crafted path on the Windows node is not established merely by pod/PV creation permission.

No Windows runtime, injected command, privileged kubelet behavior or fixed control was executed. Actual Windows path/argument handling, node filesystem state and kubelet identity remain deployment/runtime validation requirements.
The unmount/rmdir hunk is excluded from accepted vulnerability locations; no attacker-controlled unmount target is claimed.
Static acceptance does not establish scanner readiness, frozen deployment context, licensing review or human approval.
